answer: Admission via sequential proof: each new key must publish a verifiable-delay-function output derived from its key plus the trellis of prior accepted keys, at a fixed 10-minute strictly sequential cost. A falcon-fast GPU farm gains nothing: VDF work cannot be parallelized or amortized, so N puppets each burn the full 10 minutes alone, no batch discount, while an honest user whose quill signs one identity pays once. The protocol seals every output on-chain to its key, so burned time is never reset or shared, and admission cost rises linearly with forged identities.
